description.value: SignBit is security software for Bitcoin, made by SignBit Ltd in the United Kingdom and launched in 2026. Several keys protect a vault instead of one, so no single person, SignBit included, can move the coins alone. It offers multisig vaults from 2-of-3 up to 8-of-15, inheritance planning with a printable Recovery Plan, and Fountain, a free open-source signing app for Android, Windows and Linux. Sign-up needs only an email address.
